items.name: Automated Tests
items.description: A suite the agent can run to check its own work

items.name: Browser Automation
items.description: The agent can drive a real browser — see rendered pages, click, and verify its own UI work

items.name: Code Intelligence
items.description: Language-server diagnostics, so the agent sees errors as an IDE would

items.name: Context Compaction
items.description: Long sessions summarize instead of falling over at the context limit — Enable session compaction so long-running work survives the window

items.name: Continuous Delivery
items.description: Agent changes ship through the same gate as human ones

items.name: Data Access
items.description: The agent can query real data rather than reasoning about schemas it cannot see

items.name: Embeddings
items.description: Text can be turned into vectors — the prerequisite for any retrieval — Configure an embedding model; a small local one is usually enough

items.name: Evaluation
items.description: Agent output measured against known-good cases rather than judged by vibes — Collect cases where the agent failed and turn them into a suite you can re-run

items.name: Extended Context
items.description: A model configured well past the default window, so long files and sessions survive — Set an explicit context limit per model — most runtimes silently default to 4K and truncate

items.name: File Editing
items.description: The agent can read and modify files directly

items.name: Hosted Inference
items.description: At least one hosted model provider configured

items.name: Local Embeddings
items.description: Retrieval that never sends your text to a third party — Run the embedding model locally — nomic-embed or bge-small are small enough

items.name: Local Runtime
items.description: A model server running on your own hardware — Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, or LiteRT

items.name: Local Tool Calling
items.description: A local model that reliably emits tool calls — the threshold where local models stop being chat toys and start doing agent work — Pull a tool-capable local model (Qwen coder, Hermes, Command-R) and verify it emits tool calls — many local models claim support and fail in practice

items.name: Model Routing
items.description: More than one model available, with agents pinned to the right tier for their work — Pin cheap models to mechanical subagents and reserve the expensive tier for hard reasoning

items.name: Notifications
items.description: Long-running work can reach you when it finishes or needs a decision — configured, but Scheduled Work is not in place yet

items.name: Observability
items.description: Traces of what agents did, so failures are diagnosable after the fact

items.name: Offline Capable
items.description: The full loop — inference, tools, retrieval — runs with the network off — Verify the agent still completes a real task with the network disabled

items.name: Parallel Execution
items.description: Several agents working at once on independent pieces — Split a broad task across subagents that do not touch the same files

items.name: Persistent Memory
items.description: Facts survive between sessions, so the agent stops relearning your setup every time

items.name: Private Data Handling
items.description: Sensitive material is processed only by models you control — Route work touching sensitive data to local models by policy, not by habit

items.name: Retrieval
items.description: The agent pulls relevant context on demand instead of being handed everything up front — Wire retrieval into a skill or agent so context is fetched rather than pasted

items.name: Review Loop
items.description: A second agent checks the first one's output before you see it — configured, but Subagents is not in place yet

items.name: Scheduled Work
items.description: Agents that run on a schedule or a trigger, without you starting them — Move a recurring check onto a schedule instead of remembering to run it

items.name: Secret Management
items.description: Credentials resolved from a vault or env references instead of literals in config

items.name: Self-Hosted Stack
items.description: Your own hardware serving models and tools to your agents — Move inference onto a machine you own and reach it over a private network

items.name: Shell Execution
items.description: The agent can run commands and read their output

items.name: Skill Library
items.description: Reusable procedures the agent loads on demand, so expertise is not retyped per session — Write a SKILL.md for a workflow you explain more than twice

items.name: Subagents
items.description: Named agents with their own prompts and models, delegated to for specific work — configured, but Model Routing is not in place yet

items.name: Tool Protocol
items.description: At least one MCP server, giving the agent capabilities beyond its own context

items.name: Vector Store
items.description: Somewhere to keep and search those vectors — Add a vector store — pgvector or a local LanceDB is enough to start

items.name: Version Control
items.description: Git operations, so agent work is reviewable and revertible

items.name: Web Research
items.description: Live search and fetch, so the agent is not limited to its training cutoff
